[BYD](https://cnevpost.com/byd/) (HKEX: 1211) has confirmed it will unveil its first humanoid robot in August, becoming the latest Chinese automaker to move into the robotics race.

# Robot Phone Honor released the world's first robot phone in August 2026. The Honor Robot Phone is the world's first robot phone launched by Honor. This product integrates an AI phone, embodied intelligence, and a camera module. This product integrates AI, robot mobility, and image capture functions, achieving environmental perception, self-learning, and intelligent decision-making, thereby expanding the functional scope of traditional phones.
